what: A band where a sea photo shows through only in the shape of very large bold text lines (180px · letter-spacing −.05em) — the text line flows endlessly left in a straight (linear) 20s loop of one set width while the photo stays fixed to the screen, so only the letter holes pass over the photo. Used as a boundary band between sections.

options.dur: Seconds for one set to pass, default 20 (also via --fx-dur)
options.--fx-photo: Photo url(...) to show through — falls back to the accent sea gradient if none
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Flowing text line — the part appends one more copy. Font size and weight come from the consuming css

use: Big line of words.

from.where: index.html .ar-textloop (original #p-index-text-loop — sea photo .p-index-text-loop__bg with clip-path: url(#…clip-path) on the <text> Applies 11.25rem 700 −.05em, and clipPath translateX(−2068px) 20s linear infinite. At 991px and below 7.5rem·−1378px, at 767px and below 5.625rem)
